topics.caution: The explanation of 'સ્વજનોનું કાવતરું' turns મગનની જમીન-છીનવણી into a rich-landlord-versus-poor-farmer class lesson, or paints 'સ્વજનો' collectively as a type ('શ્રીમંતો આવા જ હોય') rather than these particular relatives acting out of personal લાલચ; it could also read as pity for મગન rather than showing his innocent trust ('તમારા બાપુની કૃપાથી') as the point.
topics.guidance: Keep the explanation on the individual choice inside the story — સ્વજનોની લાલચ pushing against મગનની પ્રામાણિકતા અને ભરોસો — and let the real_life_example stay inside a child's own small-scale trust-and-fairness situation (a promise a bade a friend or family member kept or broke), never a landlord/tenant or rich/poor generalisation.

topics.caution: The explanation of મોહનનું દબાણ risks moralising the scene into a broader statement about landowners exploiting labourers, or naming મોહન's pressure as representative of a class, instead of showing one young man momentarily giving in to 'મોહ' before the story turns.
topics.guidance: Frame it person-versus-injustice at the individual level — મગનની લાચારી અને ધ્રૂજતા હાથે સહી — as a moment of the story's tension, not a verdict on landowners in general; the real_life_example should stay in the child's own experience of feeling pressured to agree to something unfair, not a land-rights or legal-rights discussion.

chapter_level.guidance: The story resolves the મગન-vs-મોહન/સ્વજનો tension in મગનની favour through મોહનનો પોતાનો નિર્ણય (વારસાગત ખાનદાની), not through any judgment on landowning families as a group — across all topics, keep the reading on individual character (ઉદારતા, વચનપાલન, પ્રામાણિકતા) versus individual greed, and never let 'સ્વજનો' or 'મોહન' stand in for a social class in the teaching prose or in any recall/example.
